author: GamingBolt
description:
The Sinking City 2 dares to be different with a genre shift compared to its predecessor, but does that automatically make it a solid game? Is that ambition realized in Arkham’s flooded streets, or does it drown, pulled under by the weight of its lofty goals? We’re glad to confirm it’s the former, as this one’s definitely got enough meat on its bones to be an enjoyable experience from start to finish. 

Calvin’s effort to reverse the effects of a situation gone wrong, and the subsequent romp through a city not conducive to life strikes a great balance between the main narrative and optional side content that can provide several advantages. Join us as we sail along flooded alleys, and explore crumbling buildings to reveal why this could be a title worth your time.
title: The Sinking City 2 Review - A Bigger, Better Sequel

author: GamingBolt
description:
Mortal Shell 2 is an excellent Soulslike that gets so much right that its minor, albeit noticeable, shortcomings never managed to detract from the larger experience. Hopefully, some of the technical issues I encountered will be ironed out through post-launch patches, but even in its current state, there’s a lot here to appreciate. 

More importantly, Mortal Shell 2 feels like a significant step forward for Cold Symmetry, laying down a strong foundation for an even bigger and grander sequel should the studio ever decide to take the series further.
title: Mortal Shell 2 Review - We Were NOT READY  For This

author: GamingBolt
description:
For what it’s worth, Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor costs $9.99, which I think is a fair price for the experience it offers. 

There’s a reasonable argument that the expansion could have focused more on Enzo’s backstory rather than inserting a side story into the base game’s narrative, but I feel Hangar 13 is making an effort to connect The Old Country to the larger Mafia timeline, and so far, that approach is working well.
title: Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor DLC Review - The Final Verdict
